name: Arcadia Nature Camp
description_short: A Mass Audubon nature camp for ages 5–15 at the 734-acre Arcadia Wildlife Sanctuary in Easthampton, MA. Campers explore forests, meadows, rivers and vernal pools, play games and learn about protecting the natural world.
